description:
Podpin is a podcast player for listeners who want more than passive listening.

Follow every episode with AI-powered transcripts, save important moments with highlights and bookmarks, and come back later to the exact part that mattered.

With Podpin you can:
- Listen in a clean, focused podcast player
- Read transcripts while episodes play
- Save highlights and bookmarks
- See chapter-style structure and key insights
- Track references mentioned in episodes
- Search and revisit useful moments faster

Podpin helps turn long-form audio into something easier to learn from, review, and keep.\n\nTerms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
promotionalText: Listen, read transcripts, save bookmarks, and return to the most useful moments in every podcast episode.
whatsNew: Discover podcasts on the road with new CarPlay browsing and Siri support. Browse trending shows and categories, then confirm before following—nothing follows or plays automatically. Ask Siri to find a show or resume what is currently playing. Episode playback, sharing, mini-player reliability and transcript-based pins are also improved.
